< zayin> Here's the deal:
< zayin> At ica grapes cost 19:90kr/kg, most stores are probably around there.
< zayin> I went and bought some grapes, 35 to be exact. Together they weighed 0.410kg. That gives a unit price of 23 öre per grape.
< zayin> In the store I asked if they round down to 0 for prices under 25 öre, they did.
< zayin> From entering ica to coming out took about 2 minutes.
< zayin> So you can walk in, take one grape, go to the checkout and get the grape for 0kr in 2 minutes.
< zayin> If you want 100 grapes it takes 4 hours, counting that every 10th minute a 4-minute queue forms. ((100*2+10*4)/60=4)
< zayin> 100 grapes cost (0,410/35)*100*19.90=23.31kr which gives an hourly wage of 23.31/4=5.83kr which is about 6kr.
< zayin> A Chinese worker costs 4kr an hour and can work 60 hours a week. So 10 hours a day if you give him Sunday off (which gives a wage of 280kr a week. Ica Supermarket in årsta is open 9-22 every day so 13 hours. (That leaves 3 hours of unused time, but let's not be stingy).
< zayin> Now there are 1000000+ Chinese, if we say just 1000 of them agree to pay for the trip to Sweden in exchange for guaranteed work, we give them 280kr a week for walking back and forth to the checkout 10 hours a day "buying" one grape for 0kr.
< zayin> Through this you earn (6*60*1000)*12=4320000(income), (4*60*1000)*12=2880000(wages), 4320000-2880000=1440000. �
So 1.44 million kr per year(!)
